email_body:
Hello,

I am applying for the Graduate Engineer role with Bouygues Construction Australia on the Terra Verde Suburban Rail Loop tunnels project in Melbourne, listed on your careers portal.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site and office work in Melbourne.

Supporting engineering and construction activities on a major tunnel project, including design review, constructability and site coordination, is the kind of graduate pathway I want. I have not yet worked on Australian tunnels or temporary works, so I would be learning on the job.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could you please consider my application through the portal process?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

paragraphs: I am applying for the Graduate Engineer role with Bouygues Construction Australia on the Terra Verde project in Melbourne. I found the vacancy on your careers portal for the Suburban Rail Loop tunnels between Glen Waverley and Box Hill.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (2019).

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers each day, reviewed structural and architectural drawings and carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I tracked procurement and materials and prepared site and progress reports.

I live in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for site and office work on the Terra Verde project. I have not yet worked on Australian tunnels or temporary works, so I would be learning those parts of the role on the job.
I've attached my resume and cover letter and would be glad to talk about the graduate seat.
